name: a11
description: Build on the A11 backend: a skill that routes your agent to the A11 Cookbook, plus the A11 MCP server (@a11code/mcp) with typed tools for data, files, auth, AI and scaffolds.

interface.shortDescription: Build apps on the A11 backend
interface.longDescription: A11 is a backend for apps built with the @a11code/sdk package: end-user sign-in, files, structured data, key-value storage, AI, email, scheduled jobs, location and hosting. This plugin teaches your agent to read the A11 Cookbook, served one topic at a time with your project's A11 API key, before it writes A11 code, and adds the A11 MCP server with typed tools for the common tasks. Run `a11 init` in your project first: it stores the project's key in .a11/.env.
